answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 78 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a ripple bet on surviving 78 epochs of grading, and every wander settlement recomputes the prism schedule, so a hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 11 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
